hosted-no-host.title: The files are not published anywhere
hosted-no-host.detail: The BIMI record points to bimi.<domain>, which needs a CNAME toward this happyDomain instance to serve the logo and the certificate.

hosted-no-logo.title: No logo uploaded
hosted-no-logo.detail: happyDomain has no logo to serve for this record. This happens after importing a zone: the files cannot be recovered from DNS, upload them again.

hosted-logo-no-title.title: The logo has no <title>
hosted-logo-no-title.detail: The SVG Tiny Portable/Secure profile required by BIMI expects a <title> element naming the brand.

bimi-hosted.title: Brand Indicators for Message Identification
bimi-hosted.intro: Displays your brand logo next to your emails in the mail clients that support it. happyDomain hosts the logo and its certificate, and generates the BIMI record pointing to them.
bimi-hosted.requirements: Most mail providers (Gmail, Yahoo, Apple Mail) only display the logo with a Verified Mark Certificate or a Common Mark Certificate, and for mail passing a DMARC policy at quarantine or reject.
bimi-hosted.selector-desc: Name of the BIMI record. Use "default" unless you publish multiple logos.
bimi-hosted.logo-desc: SVG file using the SVG Tiny Portable/Secure profile (baseProfile="tiny-ps"), square, at most 32 KiB.
bimi-hosted.certificate-desc: Verified Mark Certificate (VMC) or Common Mark Certificate (CMC) issued for your logo, in PEM format, with its chain.
bimi-hosted.certificate-none: No certificate: most mail providers will not display the logo.
bimi-hosted.hosting-desc: happyDomain serves the files at bimi.{{domain}}, through a CNAME pointing to this instance.
bimi-hosted.preview-unavailable: The record is generated when the zone is saved.
bimi-hosted.logo-not-svg: This file is not an SVG image.
bimi-hosted.logo-not-tiny-ps: The logo must use the SVG Tiny Portable/Secure profile (baseProfile="tiny-ps").
bimi-hosted.logo-active-content: The logo must not contain scripts or event handlers.
bimi-hosted.logo-external-reference: The logo must not reference external resources.
bimi-hosted.certificate-too-large: The certificate file is over 64 KiB.
bimi-hosted.certificate-not-pem: This file is not a PEM certificate.
bimi-hosted.certificate-not-only-certificates: The file must only contain certificates, never a private key.

BIMI.name: BIMI (hosted logo)
BIMI.description: Display your brand logo next to your emails, with the logo and its certificate served by happyDomain.
